note.title: Media and technology
note.specFocus: Phones, computers, the internet, apps, social media, online safety, advantages and disadvantages, digital habits, games, and media sources.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Media and technology

Key vocabulary
- el móvil; la aplicación; descargar; subir; la red social; la contraseña; navegar por internet; en línea; la cuenta; el ordenador; el riesgo; la pantalla; fiable; desconectar; ciberacoso

Key grammar
- Use desde/hace for duration, se puede + infinitive for general possibilities, por/para for reason and purpose, and conditional advice. Use indirect object pronouns for messages or help given to someone.

Exam tips
- Distinguish descargar (download) from cargar (load/upload depending on context). Balance benefits with risks and give safe behaviour, not just a list of devices.

A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre los medios de comunicación y la tecnología. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see students creating a presentation on several computers. The people seem focused and in good spirits. questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Uso el móvil para organizar mis deberes y hablar con mis amigos. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Para aprender, busco páginas fiables y comparo varias fuentes.

(English: — I use my mobile to organise my homework and speak to friends. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — To learn, I search reliable sites and compare several sources.)
